title: Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) - Cushing, Oklahoma
provider: U.S. Energy Information Administration (distributed by FRED)
mapping_type: direct for crude oil price statements; proxy for diesel or fuel-cost statements
publication_pattern: Series pages seen were updated on Wednesdays with data up to the previous Monday. U.S. holidays appear as missing values.
permitted_use: Internal research and model development. Check the FRED and source terms before sharing data outside your organization.
notes: Missing values are written as a dot in the CSV.
revision_note: FRED serves the latest revised values, so historical tests use revised data, not the values known at the time.

title: Indian Rupees to U.S. Dollar Spot Exchange Rate
provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (distributed by FRED)
units: Indian Rupees to One U.S. Dollar
mapping_type: direct for INR per USD statements
publication_pattern: Series pages seen were updated on Mondays with data up to the previous Friday.
permitted_use: Internal research and model development. Check the FRED and source terms before sharing data outside your organization.
notes: Noon buying rates in New York City for cable transfers payable in foreign currencies. A higher value means a weaker rupee.
revision_note: FRED serves the latest revised values, so historical tests use revised data, not the values known at the time.
